blind_note: No observational data of any kind is loaded in this lane, so there is no blind-protection issue: nothing is fitted, no split is consumed, no holdout is touched.  KiDS and wide binaries are not loaded, listed or referenced; neither is SPARC nor any cluster catalogue.  Every constant is frozen from ../tournament/tournament.json.

tidal_scalar.label: tidal-gated scalar  a0 -> a0(1 + A/(1+(|T|/T0)^2))
tidal_scalar.verdict: |T| = 0 identically on a homogeneous background.  The frozen form is inv, W = 1/(1+I^m), BOUNDED by 1, so the gate SATURATES at its maximum rather than diverging: W = 1 and a0 -> a0 (1 + A).  The background exists.

depth_S_p0.verdict: |Phi_N| on a homogeneous background is PURE GAUGE.  The three defensible cosmological reference rules span the whole gate, from W = 0 to W = 1.  Run AH already measured the two admissible galaxy rules differing by 0.87 dex against a 0.9 dex off/on margin; in cosmology the ambiguity is total, not 0.87 dex.

tensor_S_on_homogeneous.eps_w_note: eps_w = 1e-12 so the 0/0 is not masked by the regulariser; with wellnet's default 1e-3 the empty-catalogue limit returns S = 0 by fiat
tensor_S_on_homogeneous.verdict: S on a homogeneous background is 0/0 in the continuum and pure shot noise for any finite catalogue.  The response of the homogeneous state is therefore set by the catalogue resolution, which the field equation does not specify.

deep_mond.note: the ODE solver stays on delta = 0 because it is A solution; the quartic branch is an equally valid one with identical initial data, which is what non-uniqueness means

newton.note: delta'' = C delta is linear, the trivial solution is unique, and the instability is the ordinary Jeans one

unbounded.finite_time_note: delta'' ~ delta^(1/2) is SUBlinear, so the solution is delta ~ t^4 and there is no finite-time singularity; the amplitude is unbounded but the growth is a power law, not a blow-up
unbounded.uv_note: the RATE is bounded (the attractor exponent is 2 for every k) but the AMPLITUDE grows in proportion to k with no cutoff, and the source multiplier Q diverges as k^(1/2).  Nothing in the gravity law supplies a smallest scale; only baryonic pressure would, and this lane does not include it.

normalisability.verdict: w ~ r^-(q s) = r^-2 for both frozen settings, so Int w r^2 dr grows linearly with the catalogue radius and the normalised S falls as 1/rmax.  On an unbounded homogeneous background S = 0 identically.

aqual_vs_qumond.note: normalised to their common k-perpendicular value; the two variational references agree at 0 and 90 degrees and differ in between, so 'the MOND anisotropy' is not a single number

catalogue_axis.note: a homogeneous universe represented by N discrete wells has S = shot noise with a RANDOM axis; K = exp(A W S) turns that into a growth anisotropy of the size tabulated.  The axis is real, order unity and set entirely by the catalogue resolution, which the field equation does not specify.

analytic_deep_mond.note: Q_n = nu (1 + L_nu/n) at fixed g_N; the fixed-delta column also carries the sqrt(n) reduction of |g_N| for an n-mode isotropic superposition at fixed total contrast.  In Newton all three are equal, so any departure from 1 is the theory PREFERRING one collapse geometry over another.

depth_gate_cosmological.verdict: under the Jeans-swindle rule the gate is off by 3 to 9 orders of magnitude in its argument; under any rule that references an external potential it is saturated on.  Both are defensible and they disagree about whether the mechanism exists at all.

tensor_second_order.note: the tensor contributes NOTHING at first order in delta; this is the size of the first term it does contribute, and it is a function of the catalogue radius

gate_derivative.note: the gate is second order in delta, so the LINEAR response of the tidal-gated candidate is exactly AQUAL with a0 -> a0(1+A); the gate itself contributes nothing at first order, at any epoch, for any k
